why: issue 1733 -- the ONE gate a tier runner holds across each tier's open + `setup`, so no two tiers declare entities on the shared session at once (zenoh-pico's declare path is unsynchronized, and the backend session is reached through `&mut` aliases). The runners that spawn every tier at once (native C++, Linux Rust, NuttX Rust) hold it; the RTOS runners chain their spawns instead (issue #144). `no_std`, allocation-free, one atomic flag, backoff through the platform sleep. rclrs has no tier model and no shared-session setup to serialize.
